findings.passage: I will help strengthen the integrity of our elections by requiring paper ballots be printed to ensure the results of our elections are accurate.
findings.note: From his 2022 Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey answer on key campaign messages. It is about election integrity through printed paper ballots. It does not mention voter ID or proof of citizenship.

findings.passage: "Our state's election website makes it simple for Hoosiers to register to vote or ensure their registration is accurate," Hall said. "It also has all the information you need to know on where to vote, the candidates on your ballot and even what Indiana is doing to maintain election security."
findings.note: Quote in a caucus press release about the voter registration deadline, praising the state election website. It mentions election security in general. It does not mention voter ID or proof of citizenship. Another legislator in the same release lists the ID and citizenship needed to register.
